justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, enum JobState, and typed QueueError cover the main domain distinctions, though Job.retry_at uses Option<Instant> rather than encoding retry-vs-not in the state enum itself.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinct UnknownJob/NotRunning variants and Display impl; uses an undocumented expect("job present") and an assert! in new (panic on invalid input) without doc justification.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Doc comments on all public items, sensible derives, and clean accessors, though CheckedOut lacks Debug and QueueError doesn't implement std::error::Error.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, derives, and ok_or, but uses map_or(false, ...) instead of is_some_and, clones the payload on checkout, and the checkout loop with re-lookup via expect is awkward rather than using a single iterator/find pattern.
